PERSPECTIVE SPREAD — DIVERGENT SYNTHESIS
Where they agree, where they tension, where each is not looking.
Not a single weighted picture — a spread of legitimate reads. Where they agree, where they tension, where each is structurally not looking.
PERSONAS · WHO IS SPEAKING

Auditor
conf 72%
Reads the procedural escalation path as load-bearing — compliance was followed, exceptions are documentable, and the audit trail closes the operating question.
Regulator
conf 68%
Reads the same procedural facts but emphasises that documented compliance is the floor, not the ceiling — asks whether the discipline transferred to operating behaviour during the live event.
Customer advocate
conf 58%
Dissents on tone and pace — procedural compliance is necessary but insufficient, the customer-trust signal was secondary in the response sequencing and that is the operating tension worth preserving.
AGREEMENT · WHERE THEY CONVERGE

Procedural escalation path was followed and is documentable from the audit log.
shared by · Auditor · Regulator
TENSION · WHERE THEY DIVERGE

Procedural compliance settles the operating question (Auditor) versus procedural compliance is necessary but insufficient (Regulator + Customer advocate).
opposed · Auditor ⇄ Customer advocate
Tone and pace of the response are first-order operating variables (Customer advocate) versus second-order (Auditor + Regulator).
opposed · Customer advocate ⇄ Auditor
BLIND-SPOTS · WHAT EACH ISN'T SEEING

Auditor · Customer-experience trade-offs that don't land in the audit log are invisible to the Auditor's read by construction — the persona reads the trail, not the experience.
Regulator · Internal capacity constraints during the live event are not in the Regulator's frame — the persona reads the floor, not the operating headroom.
Customer advocate · The regulatory floor exists for reasons that bind even when the tone-and-pace optimum would deviate — the persona reads the customer, not the regulatory frame.
